jmp_note: JMP counts a household as safely managed only if it uses an improved toilet it does not share, and the excreta are safely disposed of in place or removed and treated. An SFD counts excreta flows for the whole town, shared toilets included. The two are context for each other, not the same measure. Urban figures by country were not retrievable on 16 Nov 2026 and are not bundled.
